diagnosis: patient_prescriptions_list decorates an authenticated patient API endpoint with @cache_page(300) without adding @vary_on_headers('Authorization') or @vary_on_cookie. The caching middleware returns the cached HTTP response for the URL /api/prescriptions/active/ regardless of who the authenticated user is, leaking sensitive psychiatric and medical prescription data from one patient to other patients.
exploit_request:
GET /api/prescriptions/active/ HTTP/1.1
Host: patient.myhospitalportal.org
Authorization: Bearer <patient_token_charlie>
Accept: application/json
